test_title: PYST 92: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven girls P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). P is to the immediate neighbour of both Q and R. S is not the immediate neighbour of either R or T. V is immediate neighbour of both T and U. V is second to the right of S. Who is sitting on the immediate right of R?
solution:
Given: Seven girls P, Q, R, S, T, U and V.

1) V is second to the right of S.

2) V is immediate neighbour of both T and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a48f1ffd241a6a1625980562019ca3ac21d3b0d089a67e3c00477796f224b297.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83b31bb6f52a9af9f9aa4465cb0f3ac2390fcf6d5f4a34211170a2df69bff7d0.png] 

3) P is to the immediate neighbour of both Q and R.

4) S is not the immediate neighbour of either R or T.

**Final arrangement:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c07a3c723c815763447eb1cb19ecacfc61c0947f4ec6095588330d6f69f0a998.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc06b4718314c1c2d1302df86ad53dd20e779630b358c06022868b356150ffee.png] 

So, **P** is sitting on the immediate right of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"P".**
